extras.real_size: hot air balloon, approx. 15.4 x 15.4 x 20.8 m (W x D x H), envelope 16.5 m tall, basket 1.4 x 1.2 x 1.1 m
extras.notes: basket stands on the ground (z = 0); envelope made of 15 soft gores (coral, butter, mint, sky, lavender) with cream crown and skirt; burner frame with two burners, padded rods, flying wires, sandbags and fuel tanks inside the basket; no moving parts; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
